content.rendered:
XECH – Hydroboil Lite Handy Travel Kettle

Introducing Hydroboil Lite – the handy travel kettle that’s as stylish as it is practical. Its innovative bottle shape ensures easy portability, while the concealed power cord ensures hygiene while making sure you don’t lose it. It comes with a cool touch exterior to make sure you can use & carry it on the go!

It has a powerful heating element that boils water in under 2 mins. It is equipped with multi-voltage, meaning you can use it at homes with 220V or even trains which have 110V, making it the ideal travel kettle.

With safety features like auto-shut down, boil dry protection & 304 grade stainless steel, Hydroboil Lite is perfect for working professionals, travel enthusiasts, health-conscious individuals. Boil water on the go with Hydroboil Lite!
